name: Manastorm floor XP: a run with a max-level member grants no floor XP to its lower-level members
contract: repeatable RDF 258 quest XP for every run member below MaxPlayerLevel on each completed floor. On Rexxar a
level-60 player cleared a difficulty-2 run while a level-56 member collected that reward on 26 floors in about
12 minutes (run 149, 2026-11-11) and reached 60 without fighting. A run that holds a member at MaxPlayerLevel now
grants no floor XP to anyone. This realm's effective MaxPlayerLevel is 80, so the carrier is level 80.
In a dungeon every group member on the map shares kill XP regardless of distance, so the carried member holds
Servant's Errand (192), whose SPELL_AURA_MOD_XP_PCT -100 covers only the kill XP source; the floor reward is
quest XP and stays payable. Floor XP settles in the same update as the objective death, so XP is read right
after the kill, before the next floor's teleport can add exploration XP. Kill XP sharing is unchanged.
